subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this umbrella remain open until the structured reply metadata contract and final fallback semantics land, or should maintainers close it after splitting those responsibilities to PR 90745 or successors and issue 87561?
rationale: The issue crosses a new Control UI-to-runtime metadata contract and a separate channel delivery fallback contract, so automation should not choose the permanent ownership split while both canonical paths are still open.

options.title: Keep umbrella until both slices resolve
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface tracker until a structured reply metadata PR lands and issue 87561 settles the no-output/fallback delivery behavior.

options.title: Split and close to canonicals
options.body: Close this umbrella only after posting a maintainer note that reply metadata is owned by PR 90745 or a successor and fallback delivery is owned by issue 87561.

options.title: Narrow to reply metadata only
options.body: Retitle or update this issue to drop the no-output fallback portion and let issue 87561 remain the sole final-delivery tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until both slices resolve
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface tracker until a structured reply metadata PR lands and issue 87561 settles the no-output/fallback delivery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current unmerged candidate implementation for the structured runtime reply metadata portion, which is the blocking code path for this issue.
